## INCOMING NAVAL UPDATE - STAGING

In the event you've been living under a rock the Naval Update is coming with the February wipe!

![Image](https://files.facepunch.com/Errn/1b2011b1/staging.png)

We're encouraging anyone with the extra time and passion for its success to go play a bit of the [staging branch](https://rust.facepunch.com/staging) (beta) between now and then.  Your feedback is valuable to us and you can submit that feedback using the F7 reporting system built into the game!

To access Staging, simply download it from your Steam library!

## RUST 12 - ART OF RUST

The Art of Rust community have out done themselves once a again. They have a custom server where people from the community can decorate their own plots.

They put together a tour for us and dedicated some of it to Rust's 12th Birthday.  They had concerts, fireworks, and much more.

This is mostly going to be a photo dump and in no way could I ever capture how beautiful and heartwarming these scenes were using still photos, but being there was absolutely magical.

I did manage to clip some of the opening concert (thanks Oriwell!) before the tour started though.  Its not very edited sorry not sorry.

[YouTube Video](https://youtu.be/RFMAdPppadY)

Here's a hefty photo dump.  If you're reading this on Steam go to the web blog for more!
